name: NeRF Synthesis via DVGO
definition: Flattens the 3D density grid $V^{(d)}$ and feature grid $V^{(f)}$ of DVGO into 2D grids $I^{(d)}$ and $I^{(f)}$ along the Z-axis to apply 2D texture synthesis methods, treating each unit as storing density and feature values instead of RGB.
summary: NeRF Synthesis via DVGO generates large-scale radiance fields by flattening 3D voxel grids into 2D textures, enabling efficient synthesis of repetitive structures using established 2D texture synthesis algorithms.
